key_catalyst: US-Iran military strikes escalate with Iran claiming Strait of Hormuz closure, spiking oil and driving risk-off in equity futures
reasoning: Three distinct, actively-escalating catalysts are converging with no sign of market absorption: US-Iran strikes with a claimed Strait of Hormuz closure driving Brent up over 3%, an SK Hynix -13% sell-the-news crash that triggered a Kospi circuit breaker and is spilling into global chip sentiment, and surging Treasury yields (2-year at a 15-month high) ahead of Tuesday's CPI and Chair Warsh's testimony. The QQQ pre-market is down -1.21% with all three catalysts unresolved and still developing, indicating the market has not digested the risk and forward risk remains elevated into the session.
